Method of Attack: Trojan Dropper used to download and install a Trojan Downloader on compromised Android devices
Decrypts and executes malicious code stored within mutter.zip file in app resources
Used to show intrusive advertising and steal money via paid subscriptions
Discoverer: Kaspersky security researchers Igor Golovin and Anton Kivva
Attack Vector: Malicious advertising library integrated into CamScanner app via third party SDK (AdHub)
Indicators of Compromise: MD5 hashes of Necro.n malware samples
Command and control (C2) server domains used in the campaign
